mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25pp over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in new housing starts over the prior 3 months signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has increased by at least 1% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in new housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong consumer spending momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index, 2017=100), it signals contraction in manufacturing output and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE has increased by at least 0.2pp over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) indicates restrictive monetary policy amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 315, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals contraction in the housing sector and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
